entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I need to return an item I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you. I see your recent order for the Aero Race Jersey. To understand the situation better, could I ask what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual medium, but this model is just too tight in the shoulders. It's the wrong size for me.

I understand completely. Our race-fit items can definitely have a more compressive feel. Let me check the policy for you. I see the jersey was delivered 51 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so processing this is no problem at all. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?

Oh, great. An exchange for a large would be perfect. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and dropping it off, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase, just for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking. While I can't provide a discount code for a sizing preference exchange, I can confirm that the entire process is free of charge. I'm sending you a pre-paid return label right now, and as soon as the carrier scans your return package, we'll ship out the new jersey to you at no cost.
I see. So no small credit or anything? I'm going to be buying more gear for the spring season soon.

I'm afraid our policy on goodwill credits is quite strict in these situations. But I can assure you we'll make the exchange process as fast and seamless as possible to get you that better-fitting jersey quickly.
Alright, that's fair. As long as the exchange is quick. So, a large size will be sent out once I drop this one off?

That's correct. The pre-paid return label has just been sent to your email. Simply print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. We'll handle the rest. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
